g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters I request /rest/products/search?q=')) to confirm a SQL syntax error. C-02 · Express API Server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Unauthenticated read of the whole SQLite database, including user credentials (declared sensitive asset) and card data. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication I collect a target email that was used for Google login, for example from feedback, reviews or the admin user list. C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend No account required No weakness linked in the register Full takeover of any OAuth-created account, including its orders, addresses, payment cards and wallet, without access to the Google identity. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access Attacker enumerates and retrieves records for arbitrary object IDs; no ownership comparison is performed. C-02 · Express API Server Regular account required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An anonymous attacker uploads a ZIP to POST /file-upload whose entry is named ../../ftp/legal.md (or any path under the app root); extractZipBuffer() writes entry.path relative to uploads/complaints/, and the guard only checks that the resolved path contains the app directory, so files anywhere in the application tree are overwritten. C-02 · Express API Server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-005) Unauthenticated overwrite of served files, configuration, or application code under the working directory, enabling defacement or code replacement. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Server-side eval of persisted user input I log in as any customer and POST /profile with username #{global.process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id')}. C-02 · Express API Server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Remote code execution as the server process: full read/write of the database, keys and all customer data. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers I craft a /#/search?q= link whose value is an HTML payload with a javascript: iframe. C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-004) Script execution in the victim's session: token theft, account takeover and arbitrary actions as the victim. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests I complete Google OAuth for my own account and copy the access_token from the redirect fragment. C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required No weakness linked in the register Login CSRF: the victim acts inside an attacker-owned account, so entered addresses, cards and order data become visible to the attacker. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Dependency Install Scripts Run at Build Time: Without --ignore-scripts, any compromised dependency publisher can execute postinstall code at build time. C-08 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
